details:
This update for google-osconfig-agent fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-61801: github.com/moby/sys/user: unbounded parsing of user and group database files can lead to denial of
  service (bsc#1284870).
- CVE-2026-78659: golang.org/x/net/http2: HTTP/2 server memory exhaustion due to Trailer headers (bsc#1286994).
- CVE-2026-78660: golang.org/x/net/http2: HTTP/2 transport accepts malformed framing-related headers (bsc#1287058).
- CVE-2026-78661: golang.org/x/net/html: quadratic complexity when coalescing text nodes (bsc#1289368).
- CVE-2026-78663: golang.org/x/net/http2: double flow control refund on HTTP/2 server streams (bsc#1287137).
- CVE-2026-78669: golang.org/x/net/http2: excessive CPU consumption from repeated initial window changes (bsc#1285283).
- CVE-2026-79775: github.com/diskfs/go-diskfs: malformed SquashFS image can cause crashes and persistent CPU loops in
  rclone's archive backend (bsc#1278163).
- CVE-2026-95838: github.com/containerd/containerd: processing of certain image layers causes superlinear time
  complexity in unpack handler and can lead to DoS (bsc#1285135).
- CVE-2026-97032: golang.org/x/net/http2: HTTP/2 server crash due to HPACK encoder race (bsc#1287487).
- CVE-2026-97045: golang.org/x/net/html: missing checks can cause parser to resolve a subtree in a different foreign
  namespace upon re-parsing rendered output (bsc#1289424).
- CVE-2026-109425: github.com/tink-crypto/tink-go/v2/keyset: missing structural validation in NewHandleWithNoSecrets()
  allows malformed public keysets (bsc#1285110).
- CVE-2026-116585,CVE-2026-116586,CVE-2026-116587: github.com/go-jose/go-jose/v4: multiple security issues in
  github.com/go-jose/go-jose before 4.1.6 (bsc#1288375).
- CVE-2026-116591: github.com/klauspost/compress/zstd: crafted ~27 KB two-block zstd frame makes DecodeAll and the
  streaming decoder panic (bsc#1288461).

Changes for google-osconfig-agent:

- Update to version 20261105.03:
  * E2E tests v2 redesign: migrate PackageResource Googet tests (#1073)
  * Fix race between osconfig reboot and Windows TrustedInstaller reboot (#1082)
  * E2E tests v2 redesign: migrate PackageResource Msi tests (#1074)
  * E2E V2: Migrate guest policy package repository case (#1058)
  * E2E tests v2 redesign: migrate PackageResource Yum tests (#1068)
  * E2E tests v2 redesign: migrate PackageResource Deb tests (#1063)
  * e2e v2: migrate os patch job execution (#1061)
  * E2E tests v2 redesign: migrate RepositoryResource Apt tests (#1075)
  * Add unit tests for zypper.go (#1014)
  * Add unit tests for util/util.go (#995)
  * Add scalibr flow for windows (#1037)
  * Add scalibr os benchmarks (#1044)
